prompt:
A battle background for a side-on JRPG battle scene (the party will stand on the right, monsters on the left; no characters are drawn), in rich high-resolution 2D pixel art. The world is in an endless night: the sun has vanished and people live by lamplight. Setting: a misty swamp at night. Back (top 42%): layers of fog, silhouettes of twisted swamp trees and a distant bell tower with one faint lamp, a dim moon behind mist. Ground (lower 58%): muddy ground and shallow still water with reeds, lily pads and roots at the sides. Light: pale green-blue fog glow, deep shadows. The ground plane recedes from the bottom edge up to the horizon line at a low 3/4 angle; the middle of the ground (from 55% to 90% of the height, centre and right) is open, fairly flat and uncluttered: space for the battle. Details (rocks, plants, debris) sit at the sides and far away. 
No lantern, no fire in the middle, no people, no monsters, no text, no UI.
Pixel art: every art pixel is 4x4 image pixels (the image is 960 x 540 art pixels), crisp square pixels, no anti-aliasing, hue-shifted colour ramps (shadows toward violet, lights toward warm yellow), clusters with clear shapes, not a painting.
revised_prompt: Create a wide 16:9 side-on JRPG battle BACKGROUND ONLY, no characters. Misty swamp at night. Upper 42% background: layered luminous pale green-blue fog, silhouetted gnarled twisted swamp trees, far-off bell tower with exactly one very faint warm yellow lamp, dim moon obscured behind mist. Lower 58%: receding muddy ground and shallow still dark water with sparse reflections, reeds, lily pads, crooked roots around side edges. The walkable ground plane recedes from bottom edge to horizon at a low three-quarter angle. CRITICAL gameplay layout: center and right middle ground from 55% through 90% image height must remain open, flat, fairly uncluttered, clearly usable for standing JRPG party sprites; the left portion usable for monsters; all foreground rocks, roots, plants, debris confined to margins or far distance. Atmospheric pale green-blue fog glow against deep shadowy violet hue-shifted ramps; subtly warm yellow lamp light only very far away. Strong depth, readable silhouettes, richly designed but restrained set dressing. NO lantern or fire in middle; no foreground focal prop, no people, no monsters, no creatures, no text, no UI, no HUD, no borders.
